name_zh: 黎巴嫩·蒙杰姆：宗派权力分享与内战诗人雪松
name_en: Lebanon Gemayel: Sectarian Power Sharing & Civil War Poets Cedars
description_zh: 巴希尔·杰马耶勒 (1947-1982) / 阿明·杰马耶勒 (1942-) 马龙派领袖/总统，1943国民契约确立宗派权力分享(马龙派总统/逊尼总理/什叶议长)，1975-1990内战雪松革命，诗歌与战争交织。
description_en: Bashir Gemayel (1947-1982) / Amine Gemayel (1942-) Maronite leader/President, 1943 National Pact established sectarian power sharing (Maronite President/Sunni PM/Shia Speaker), 1975-1990 civil war Cedar Revolution, poetry and war intertwined.
reason_zh: 杰马耶勒家族代表黎巴嫩宗派制如何通过权力分享维持脆弱平衡，展示了内战如何在宗派固化体制中反复爆发，雪松革命与诗歌抵抗成为民族和解的文化符号。
reason_en: Gemayel family represents how Lebanese sectarianism maintains fragile balance through power sharing, demonstrating how civil war repeatedly erupts in sectarian solidified system, Cedar Revolution and poetic resistance becoming national reconciliation cultural symbols.
steps_zh: 研究杰马耶勒家族马龙派精英与法兰西银行财阀背景
分析1943国民契约宗派配额制与总统/总理/议长分配
探讨1975内战爆发与以色列入侵/叙利亚干预
评估1982巴希尔当选遇刺与1989塔伊夫协议调整
总结宗派权力分享内战诗人雪松对黎巴嫩共存模式的悲剧性定型
steps_en: Study Gemayel family Maronite elite and Banque Française wealth background
Analyze 1943 National Pact sectarian quota President/PM/Speaker allocation
Explore 1975 civil war outbreak and Israeli invasion/Syrian intervention
Evaluate 1982 Bashir election assassination and 1989 Taif Agreement adjustment
Summarize sectarian power sharing civil war poets cedars tragic shaping of Lebanese coexistence model
expected_zh: 理解宗派配额如何既是建国基石又是冲突根源，掌握内战在固化体制中周期性爆发的机制，评估黎巴嫩模式对伊拉克波黑等后冲突权力分享的示范与警示。
expected_en: Understand how sectarian quota is both state-building foundation and conflict root, grasp civil war periodic eruption mechanism in solidified system, evaluate Lebanese model demonstration and warning for Iraq Bosnia post-conflict power sharing.
case_zh: 1943 国民契约；1975 内战；1989 塔伊夫；2005 雪松革命。宗派权力分享内战诗人雪松范式永存。
case_en: 1943 National Pact; 1975 civil war; 1989 Taif; 2005 Cedar Revolution. Sectarian power sharing civil war poets cedars paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Sectarian power sharing; civil war; Cedar Revolution; poetry resistance
